title: ait-destruction
description:
This module adds one that can be destroyed TARDIS props, remember not to let your bad friends into your TARDIS
本模组增加了一个可以毁灭TARDIS的道具，记住别让你的损友进入你的TARDIS
body:
For Adventures in Time module Add TARDIS self-destructive device. Use the destruction device to align TARDIS external or internal blocks can initiate a 60-second self-destruct sequence. The self-destruct process is divided into four stages: spatiotemporal instability (purple particles and low hum) → structural decay (lava sparks and alarm bells) → spatiotemporal fracture (blue-white arcs and small explosions) → dimensional collapse (red flames and large explosions). Self-destruct period TARDIS the alarm continues to sound, and the player will be automatically transmitted to the outside during the collapse phase, then TARDIS lock the door and destroy it completely.
为 Adventures in Time 模组添加 TARDIS 自毁装置。使用毁灭装置对准 TARDIS 外部方块或在其内部使用，即可启动 60 秒自毁序列。自毁过程分为四个阶段：时空失稳（紫色粒子与低沉嗡鸣）→ 结构衰减（熔岩火花与警报钟声）→ 时空断裂（蓝白电弧与小型爆炸）→ 维度崩塌（红色火焰与大型爆炸）。自毁期间 TARDIS 警报持续响起，玩家将在崩塌阶段被自动传送至外部，随后 TARDIS 门锁死并彻底毁灭。
